narrator.instruct: Gripping, energetic storyteller telling a palace mystery, brisk and suspenseful, never calm.

king.instruct: Cold, confident king, quietly amused. Firm, crisp and commanding, no long pauses.

thief.instruct: Cocky young palace guard, mocking and loud, a nervous laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's gone. The Queen's necklace vanished from a locked throne room.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every door was bolted. So the thief is one of these twelve guards.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The King locks them in and hands each guard the same wooden stick.

lines.speaker: king
lines.text: These are my wizard's sticks. Tonight, the thief's stick grows one inch.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One guard can't stop grinning.

lines.speaker: thief
lines.text: Then measure mine first!

lines.speaker: king
lines.text: Tomorrow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: All night, the guards stare at their sticks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At midnight, one measures his against the floor tiles.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Another holds his up to a snoring friend's stick.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the grinning guard hides his stick inside his jacket.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Just before sunrise, a faint scraping comes from the corner. Then silence.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By morning, the guards lay their sticks side by side.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Eleven match perfectly. One is shorter.

lines.speaker: thief
lines.text: That's impossible! It was supposed to grow!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He freezes. Too late.

lines.speaker: king
lines.text: The necklace.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Here's the trick. These were never a wizard's sticks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They came from the palace woodshed. No stick could ever grow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So the innocent guards had no reason to touch theirs.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Only the thief believed. So he shaved one inch off the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The King never measured anything. The thief did it for him.
